target.title: Add visible cost scale labels to cost charts
target.body: ## Summary Adds visible cost scale labels across the cost chart surfaces covered by #1854: - Detailed cost history submenu chart now has leading currency y-axis tick labels and a plot-aware x-axis. - Inline menu-card mini bars now show a compact top-right max-cost label for currency dashboards. - Widget history charts now show a compact max-cost label when every displayed point has cost data. - Widget history charts now use one explicit mode per chart, fixing a mixed-unit bug where partial cost data could render some bars as dollars and others as tokens. Closes #1854. ## Changes ### Detailed cost history chart - `AxisMarks(position: .leading, values: yAxisTickValues(maxCostUSD:))` renders compact currency tick labels on the left side. - Whole-dollar labels are used for values ≥ $1 (`$0`, `$757`, `$1,515`); nonzero sub-dollar labels keep cents (`$0.50`) to avoid duplicate `$0` ticks. - Empty/flat data uses an empty tick set. - Replaced the manual full-width date `HStack` with Swift Charts' `chartXAxis`, so the x-axis aligns to the plot area instead of the outer container. - Edge date labels use leading/trailing anchors to avoid clipping. ### Inline menu-card mini bars - `InlineUsageDashboardModel` now carries an optional `currencyCode`. - Currency dashboard builders populate it for cost dashboards: - local/API cost history dashboards use the snapshot currency code, - Claude Admin API and OpenRouter use USD, - CrossModel uses its reported currency. - Token/points dashboards leave `currencyCode` nil, so they do not show a dollar label. - `MiniUsageBars` overlays a compact top-right max-cost label only when a currency code exists and max cost is positive. ### Widget history charts - `UsageHistoryChart` now chooses a single chart mode before rendering. - Cost mode is used only when every displayed point has `costUSD`; otherwise the chart renders token counts and suppresses the dollar label. - This avoids mixing dollars and tokens in one widget chart when daily points are partially populated. - Large/switcher/history widget call sites pass through the token usage currency code for cost-mode labels. ### Existing detail/tooltip formatting unchanged - Compact scale labels are chart-local. - Detail rows, tooltips, totals, and summary text still use the existing full currency formatting paths. ## Screenshot ## Video https://cap.so/s/p2506ammwdttz9w ## Testing - `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer swift test --filter CostHistoryChartMenuViewTests` — 13 tests passed. - `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer swift test --filter InlineCostHistoryDashboardLabelTests` — 5 tests passed. - `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer swift test --filter CodexBarWidgetProviderTests` — 32 tests passed. - `.build/lint-tools/bin/swiftlint lint --strict --disable-sourcekit Sources Tests` — 0 violations. - `./Scripts/lint.sh format` — SwiftFormat completed. - `swift build --target CodexBarCore` — Core environment smoke passed. - `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer ./Scripts/compile_and_run.sh` — built, packaged, signed ad-hoc, relaunched `CodexBar.app`, and reported `OK: CodexBar is running.` ## Files touched - `Sources/CodexBar/CostHistoryChartMenuView.swift` - `Sources/CodexBar/InlineUsageDashboardContent.swift` - `Sources/CodexBarWidget/CodexBarWidgetViews.swift` - `Tests/CodexBarTests/CostHistoryChartMenuViewTests.swift` - `Tests/CodexBarTests/InlineCostHistoryDashboardLabelTests.swift` - `Tests/CodexBarTests/CodexBarWidgetProviderTests.swift` - `docs/screenshots/cost-chart-yaxis-labels.png`
